label: STACK MATRIX
title: Services and Tools Matrix
kicker: The stack reads best as a set of clear jobs: local app runtime, data and maps, cloud hosting, and diagnostics.

cards.title: Backend
cards.body: API endpoints plus static frontend serving.

cards.title: Frontend
cards.body: Dashboard boot, controls, panels, and API calls.

cards.title: Map service
cards.body: Cloud map SDK and services when configured.

cards.title: File storage
cards.body: Processed GeoJSON and JSON for cloud data mode.

cards.title: Records DB
cards.body: App-shaped records for routes, districts, or events.

cards.title: Telemetry
cards.body: Health, failures, latency, requests, and diagnostics.

callout: Builder move: explain services as responsibilities, not vendor names.
